stem.text: There is a theory that mitochondria and chloroplasts were originally free-living prokaryotes. It is thought that millions of years ago these free-living prokaryotes were taken into larger cells by endocytosis where, instead of being digested, they became functional organelles.
Which features of mitochondria and chloroplasts support this theory?

items: Mitochondria and chloroplasts are surrounded by double membranes.
Mitochondria and chloroplasts have small, circular DNA.
